# Private requests and security reports

GitHub only offers one private form on this repository: **Security > Report a vulnerability**
(<https://github.com/maninka123/academic-lens-lk/security/advisories/new>). It is built for software bugs,
so some boxes look strange for an ordinary request. This page tells you exactly what to type in each box.
Replace every `[PLACEHOLDER IN CAPITALS]` with your own details. Nothing you write there is public.

**You need a free GitHub account.** No account? Ask a colleague who has one to submit it for you, or use the
public form linked in the table below.

## What is this form for?

| I want to... | Use |
|---|---|
| Correct a mistake in my profile, **privately** | Part A below |
| Remove my profile, **privately** | Part B below |
| Report a real security problem with the website | Part C below |
| Make a public request (no need for privacy) | [Correction or removal request](https://github.com/maninka123/academic-lens-lk/issues/new/choose) |

We aim to reply within 14 days.

## Fill the form, box by box

| Box on the form | What to enter |
|---|---|
| **Title** (required) | `Private request: [YOUR NAME], [YOUR UNIVERSITY]` |
| **Ecosystem**, **Package name**, **Affected versions**, **Patched versions** | Leave all four **empty**. They are only for software packages. |
| **Severity** | Choose **Low**. (It does not affect how we treat your request.) |
| **Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE)** | Leave **empty**. |
| **Description** (required) | Copy Part A, B or C below, then replace the capitals. |
| **Credits**, **CVE**, **Collaborators** | Leave **empty**. |
| Final button | **Submit report**. It stays private. |

If the form shows a box that is not listed here, leave it empty.

## Part A: correct my profile (copy this into Description)

```text
REQUEST TYPE: Correction (private)

WHO I AM
Name as shown on the site: [YOUR NAME AS SHOWN]
University: [YOUR UNIVERSITY]
Department / faculty: [YOUR DEPARTMENT OR FACULTY]
Link to my profile on the site (optional): [PASTE THE PAGE ADDRESS]

WHAT IS WRONG
Field: [e.g. position / qualification / PhD university / Google Scholar link / citations]
Currently shown: [WHAT THE SITE SAYS NOW]
Should be: [THE CORRECT VALUE]

EVIDENCE (a link to an official page or my own profile is enough)
[PASTE A LINK, OR WRITE "I can send a document on request"]

HOW TO REPLY TO ME
[YOUR PREFERRED EMAIL, OR "reply here on GitHub"]
```

## Part B: remove my profile (copy this into Description)

```text
REQUEST TYPE: Removal (private)

WHO I AM
Name as shown on the site: [YOUR NAME AS SHOWN]
University: [YOUR UNIVERSITY]
Department / faculty: [YOUR DEPARTMENT OR FACULTY]

PLEASE REMOVE
[ ] My whole profile
[ ] Only these items: [LIST, e.g. photo link, Scholar link, citation numbers]

REASON (optional, you do not have to give one)
[YOUR REASON OR LEAVE THIS LINE OUT]

HOW TO REPLY TO ME
[YOUR PREFERRED EMAIL, OR "reply here on GitHub"]
```

Do not paste ID numbers, phone numbers or your home address. We do not need them.

## Part C: report a security problem (copy this into Description)

```text
REQUEST TYPE: Security report

WHAT I FOUND
[ONE SENTENCE]

WHERE
Page or file: [PAGE ADDRESS OR FILE PATH]

STEPS TO SEE IT
1. [STEP ONE]
2. [STEP TWO]
3. [WHAT HAPPENS]

WHY IT MATTERS
[WHAT AN ATTACKER OR VISITOR COULD DO, OR "not sure"]

HOW TO REPLY TO ME
[YOUR PREFERRED EMAIL, OR "reply here on GitHub"]
```

Please give us a reasonable time to fix a problem before you share it publicly.

## Supported versions

Only the live site and the `main` branch are maintained.
